crossRefs.note: But Jesus answered, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I am about to drink, and be…
But Jesus said to them, “You don’t know what you are asking. Are you able to drink the cup that I drink, and to be…
You ask, and don’t receive, because you ask with wrong motives, so that you may spend it on your pleasures.
Then Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying, “I will be king.” Then he prepared him chariots and horsemen…
Then Nathan spoke to Bathsheba the mother of Solomon, saying, “Haven’t you heard that Adonijah the son of Haggith…
Nathan said, “My lord, king, have you said, ‘Adonijah shall reign after me, and he shall sit on my throne?’
For he has gone down today, and has slain cattle, fatlings, and sheep in abundance, and has called all the king’s sons…

people.name: Abiathar
people.line: High priest during the reigns of David and Solomon

people.name: Abishag
people.line: Beautiful Shunammite who served King David

people.name: Adonijah
people.line: Son of David who attempted to seize the throne

people.name: Joab
people.line: Son of Zeruiah, commander of David's army

people.name: Shunammites
people.line: People from Shunem; includes Abishag and the Shunammite woman

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

people.name: Zeruiah
people.line: Sister of David; mother of Joab, Abishai, and Asahel

translations.web: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Ask for him the kingdom also; for he is my elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.”
translations.bsb: King Solomon answered his mother, “Why do you request Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? Since he is my older brother, you might as well request the kingdom for him and for Abiathar the priest and for Joab son of Zeruiah!”
translations.kjv: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
translations.asv: And king Solomon answered and said unto his mother, And why dost thou ask Abishag the Shunammite for Adonijah? ask for him the kingdom also; for he is mine elder brother; even for him, and for Abiathar the priest, and for Joab the son of Zeruiah.
